description: This file defines a mock class 'ServiceMock' for unit testing purposes, mocking the interface 'WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell' and its nested 'ICOMLink' interface. It uses Google Mock to define mock methods for the various functions of these interfaces, enabling controlled testing of components that depend on 'IShell' implementations.

classes.description: A mock class for 'WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell' and 'IShell::ICOMLink' interfaces, providing mock implementations for unit testing.
